name: Hitzones
description: Reimagines hitboxes with the player as a point

enabled.name: Enabled by default
enabled.description: Hitzones will already be visible when entering a level

hitzones-on-death.name: Hitzones on death
hitzones-on-death.description: When dead, hitzones will be visible

fill-opacity.name: Fill opacity
fill-opacity.description: Opacity of the inside area of the hitzones

border-opacity.name: Border opacity
border-opacity.description: Opacity of the borders of the hitzones

show-trail-line.name: Show trail line
show-trail-line.description: Shows the green path that trails the player

show-player-center-point.name: Show player center point
show-player-center-point.description: Shows a red point at the player's center

show-input-indicators.name: Show input indicators
show-input-indicators.description: Shows a blue or orange point when the player clicks or releases
